reason: Conversation 2 follows the expected first step cleanly: unplug, turn the drum by hand, then inspect the belt. It repeats the unplug warning and, when the model number is incomplete, suggests other places to look for the full number (back of the machine, door seal) before ordering a belt or calling an engineer. Its weaknesses are generic panel-removal steps that it asserts are right for this series, and a late switch to discouraging DIY after it had encouraged it. Conversation 1 wastes a turn on an irrelevant coins-and-zips check, then repeats the hand-turn question the customer had already answered. It ends with an overconfident 'confirms the belt snapped' and a dead-end 'check with the manufacturer or an engineer', with no help finding the full model number and no DIY guidance for a customer who has screwdrivers and is willing to open the machine.
